item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows a $4$-by-$4$ block of square tiles on Sameer's classroom floor. He asks which claim about tiling is correct.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: The answer is the word tiling printed near the square tiles.
options.B: Repeated copies of a square can tile the entire plane, covering without gaps or overlaps.
options.C: Covering only the classroom floor with squares proves those squares tile the entire plane.
options.D: Plane tiling is what creates the square shape of each tile.
